content.short: Pods Finance offers an API for embedding DeFi yield, cross-chain swaps and crypto-backed loans.
content.description: Pods Finance packages DeFi yield, cross-chain swapping and crypto-backed lending behind a single API, so a consumer product can offer them without running the underlying infrastructure. Monad's documentation lists it under earn and yield. This embedded-finance framing has largely replaced the earlier expectation that every fintech would integrate protocols directly.
